concept: Grünraum – fiktive Website für Garten- und Landschaftsbau

assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: wide website hero image for a fictional premium German garden and landscape construction company
Primary request: a completed contemporary family garden that feels lived-in, natural and professionally built
Scene/backdrop: renovated detached house garden in Germany with a generous light natural-stone terrace, softly curving perennial beds, multi-stem serviceberry tree, clipped but not rigid shrubs and a modest lawn
Subject: the relationship between terrace, planting and house, no people
Style/medium: high-end photorealistic editorial landscape architecture photography, natural and credible
Composition/framing: wide landscape view from garden level, strong foreground planting with clear view toward terrace and house, layered depth, suitable for a 3:2 website crop
Lighting/mood: soft warm morning light after light rain, calm, welcoming, quietly premium
Color palette: deep garden green, sage, pale limestone, warm timber, restrained flowering accents in white and muted apricot
Materials/textures: natural limestone with subtle variation, weathered timber, healthy foliage, damp soil, realistic lawn
Constraints: botanically plausible central European planting, believable drainage and construction details, no readable text, no logos, no trademarks, no people, no watermarks
Avoid: luxury mansion, tropical plants, artificial turf, exaggerated bloom, oversaturated greens, fantasy garden, CGI render, outdoor furniture catalog styling

Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: website craft-detail image for a fictional German garden and landscape construction company
Primary request: close editorial photograph of a landscaper's gloved hands precisely setting a natural stone edge beside a permeable paved path
Scene/backdrop: active but orderly residential garden construction site with prepared gravel bed, alignment string and compact hand tools
Subject: craftsmanship, accurate alignment, stone texture and build quality; only hands and forearms visible
Style/medium: photorealistic documentary craft photography
Composition/framing: landscape close-up at ground level, stone edge leading diagonally through the frame, suitable for a 4:3 crop
Lighting/mood: diffuse daylight, focused and reassuring
Color palette: pale granite, earth brown, olive workwear, deep green background
Materials/textures: rough natural stone, compacted aggregate, soil, durable fabric gloves, subtle authentic dust
Constraints: safe and physically plausible work sequence, correct tool use, no readable text, no logos, no trademarks, no identifiable person, no watermarks
Avoid: staged handshake, spotless tools, unsafe posture, random equipment, dramatic dirt, impossible paving geometry, CGI look

Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: website project image for a fictional sustainable garden case study
Primary request: a mature climate-resilient courtyard garden with a shallow rain garden integrated beside a timber deck and gravel path
Scene/backdrop: contemporary German townhouse courtyard, modest scale, privacy walls softened by planting
Subject: layered drought-tolerant perennials and grasses, multi-stem small tree, visible but subtle rainwater channel feeding a planted depression
Style/medium: photorealistic architectural and garden editorial photography
Composition/framing: wide landscape three-quarter view showing the full spatial layout and water-management logic, suitable for a 3:2 crop
Lighting/mood: bright overcast daylight after rain, fresh, calm and usable
Color palette: varied greens, straw-colored grasses, silver foliage, muted purple flowers, warm timber, light gravel
Materials/textures: timber, gravel, corten-steel edging used sparingly, wet foliage, natural stone
Constraints: botanically and hydrologically plausible central European garden, accessible walking route, no readable text, no logos, no trademarks, no people, no watermarks
Avoid: tropical jungle, huge luxury property, decorative pond, excessive corten steel, oversaturation, fantasy landscaping, CGI render
